burpsuite.description: Burp Suite MCP — 36 tools (28 official + 8 Unrestricted fork v1.3.0). Python stdio server → SSE client → Burp BApp at 127.0.0.1:9876. Tools: proxy_request, send_http1_request, send_http2_request, create_repeater_tab, send_to_intruder, get_proxy_http_history (newest_first+host_filter), get_proxy_http_history_latest, get_site_map, active_scan_url, crawl_url, repeater_send, repeater_read, generate_collaborator_payload, get_collaborator_interactions, and more. Requires: Burp running with the MCP BApp loaded and its SSE server on port 9876.

caido.description: Caido MCP — proxy history, parallel replay, fuzzing sessions. Requires: Caido running locally and CAIDO_PAT set (see .env.example).

pentest-ai.description: PentestAI MCP — automated scan orchestration, nuclei template runner, vulnerability scan results. Requires: the `ptai` CLI on PATH.

bb-recon.description: BB Recon MCP — passive subdomain enumeration, DNS resolution, HTTP probing. Bundled in this repo, no external setup.
